Every edit goes into one draft. The save bar slides up when the draft differs from the saved product and goes away again if you undo your edits by hand, because the check is a deep compare. ⌘S saves, Discard asks first, and Preview or the breadcrumb nudge the bar instead of leaving. A second try within a few seconds asks whether to leave without saving. onSave can return field errors, which are shown on their fields while the first one scrolls into view and gets focus, or a conflict, which turns the bar into “Leo Park changed this product 2 min ago” with Review changes and Overwrite.

MediaUploader

MediaUploader takes drops, pastes and the file picker. The first image is the large featured tile. You can drag tiles and the rest move out of the way as you go, or press Space, the arrow keys and Space again. Each upload shows its own progress. A failed one stays in place with Retry, unsupported types and files over the size limit are named in a message, and removed images come back with Undo.

VariantMatrix

VariantMatrix edits up to three options as value chips that you can reorder, rename and remove, and keeps one row for every combination. Rows are grouped by an option with a summary like “$48–$96 · 12 in stock”. You can set price or stock for a whole group or a selection, delete a combination and restore it with the same SKU, filter rows, and work through hundreds of variants because collapsed groups don’t render and long groups load 25 rows at a time.
